disclosure.book_returns: reconstructed from realised P&L and treasury movements, then reconciled against the equity read on both accounts; neither venue serves a usable equity history
disclosure.fills: executed by the venues; not simulated
disclosure.fx_convention: the published curve is converted at the inception rate; the spot rate, the spot-converted NAV and the difference in basis points are published in every snapshot
disclosure.hedging_notice: before that date the second leg was not funded, so what executed was not this strategy; nothing has been removed from the record
disclosure.notice: This book trades REAL capital, which belongs to the operator. No third-party money is managed. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Nothing here is investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation.
disclosure.out_of_scope_executions: fee-calibration executions on other instruments are excluded from the return and treated as a capital adjustment; their aggregate is published, their instruments are not
disclosure.return_convention: time-weighted, via unitisation: a deposit buys units at the day's price, so it moves equity and never the price

flows.note: moves equity, never the unit price

fx.basis_note: each session's broker leg is converted once, at that session's close rate, and never revalued. No exchange-rate movement therefore enters the curve
fx.delta_note: gap against the other convention -- revaluing the whole broker leg at this session's rate, as a live dashboard does. It is the only difference between this curve and the operator's local view

metrics.annualised_basis_note: measured: 400 daily bars over 564 calendar days on the broker's own calendar

nav.basis: mark-to-market, verified flat at the session close
nav.source: reconstructed from realised P&L and treasury movements

out_of_scope.note: fee calibration on other instruments; instruments not published
